defects.description: The term 'Subject' is translated as 'Субъекты' instead of the required glossary equivalent 'Объект обсуждения'.
The type identifier 'severity' in the schema definition is translated into Russian, which breaks the technical specification.
The field name 'severity' is translated into Russian in the descriptive text, making it inconsistent with the code and other field references (like 'subject_id').
